### 1 — Scene
A breakfast tray with toast, a fried egg, a muffin, juice, and two butter portions. The muffin appears to belong to the same meal, so I include it.

### 2 — Vessels
- Main plate: approximately **23 cm** diameter; area = 3.14 × 11.5² ≈ **415 cm²**.
- Muffin side plate: approximately **20 cm** diameter; area ≈ **314 cm²**.
- Juice glass: approximately **6 cm internal diameter**.

### 3 — Items
Two overlapping slices of toast, one fried egg, one muffin, yellow juice (likely orange), and two sealed butter portions. No separate quantity of cooking oil is clearly measurable; modest cooking fat is included in the fried-egg energy estimate.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Toast height below represents the average combined thickness across the overlapping slices.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Gross volume calculation | Density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Toast, two slices | Main plate: 40% | 166 cm² × 1.6 cm = 266 ml | 0.30 g/ml | 80 g | 280 | 224 kcal |
| Fried egg | Main plate: 18% | 75 cm² × 0.7 cm = 52 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 52 g | 200 | 104 kcal |
| Muffin | Side plate: 13% | 41 cm² × 4 cm = 164 ml | 0.45 g/ml | 74 g | 350 | 259 kcal |
| Juice | Glass cross-section: 100% | 28.3 cm² × 8.2 cm = 232 ml | 1.04 g/ml | 241 g | 45 | 108 kcal |
| Butter, two portions | In individual packets | Approximately 15 ml combined | 0.93 g/ml | 14 g | 717 | 100 kcal |

**Coverage check:** Toast and visible egg together cover approximately **58% of the main plate**; the muffin covers approximately **13% of its side plate**. These are consistent with the visible uncovered rims and plate surfaces.

### 8 — Sanity check
Estimated total: **461 g and 795 kcal**, including juice and the contents of both butter packets. The solid food and butter total about **220 g**, plausible for the portions shown. Muffin size and recipe are the largest uncertainties.
